name: Aimée Cassettari
bio:
A graduate of Birmingham University and The Royal Welsh College of Music and Drama, Aimee has worked as an Actor in theatre and film. Credits include: The American Dream 2.0 (The Young Vic), Last Night in Soho (Edgar Wright), BBC Doctors.

Prior to drama school, Aimee worked in Television Production as a Researcher for the BBC and as a Junior Script Editor at Left Bank Pictures

credits.title: Practical Magic 2
credits.overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

credits.title: Last Night in Soho
credits.overview: A young girl, passionate about fashion design, is mysteriously able to enter the 1960s where she encounters her idol, a dazzling wannabe singer. But 1960s London is not what it seems, and time seems to be falling apart with shady consequences.

credits.title: Coldplay
credits.overview: A girl's first date goes astray due to a pub's music taste.
